$Comment: An unseen mark a player wears while standing inside a boss arena: the room tools' ArenaWake volume covers the arena and renews it every second, so it lapses a moment after the player steps out. An encounter script built on Zc_Encounter_Base with WakeInArena true raises its boss only for a player wearing it, so the fight never starts for someone outside the door. Duration is the lapse; keep it longer than the volume's renewal.
